_comment: WhatsApp conversational components of Alo King's customer number (DECISIONS §39.15.11, session 5g): ice breakers (shown before the first message) and commands (typed with /). Set by scripts/kapso/conversational.ts through Kapso's Meta proxy. Meta keeps one set per number, so they are in English (LOG, session 5g); each tap or command answers through the bot's deterministic paths in the customer's language. Meta's limits live in supabase/functions/_shared/meta-limits.ts (META_CONVERSATIONAL). The welcome message stays off: the bot greets on the customer's first message.

Your orders and where they are
